column3: Public HTML revalidates; versioned assets use explicit immutable caching.
Sense6 intentionally serves public static content through shared caches.
Cached responses contain only public static content and no user-specific data.
Inline style attributes position generated visual stimuli; scripts remain nonce-free and hash-pinned.
Research constants in versioned JavaScript are not event timestamps or sensitive data.
Wildcard CORS exposes only the same public static resources available without credentials.
Cross-origin isolation is unnecessary because Sense6 uses no SharedArrayBuffer or embedded credentials.
